title: CZ Says Bear Market Money is Hunting, Social Capital Founder Says Skip AI Chips
excerpt: CZ says money is hunting in this bear market. Chamath Palihapitiya says it should buy land and power, not AI chips.
content_html:
Binance founder Changpeng Zhao (CZ) says this bear market has no shortage of money. Plenty of it is hunting for somewhere to go.

Elsewhere, Social Capital founder Chamath Palihapitiya said where he thinks it should land. Not in artificial intelligence (AI) chips.

The Bear Market Has Money. It Is Not Buying Crypto

CZ did not say where the money should go, but acknowledged that there was a lot of liquidity floating despite the bear market.

The numbers show why it is not going into crypto. Bitcoin (BTC) trades near $63,037. It is down 45% in a year. That is almost exactly half its October 6 record.

Chamath Is Buying Land, Not Chips

Meanwhile, the Social Capital founder Chamath Palihapitiya, a venture capitalist, entrepreneur, and investor, buys three things at once. Land, a power connection, and an empty building to hold the computers.

"LPS (Land Power Shell) is still the most obvious and fastest path to cash on cash returns," Palihapitiya wrote.

Palihapitiya is a former senior executive at Facebook (now Meta), a renowned SPAC sponsor, and former minority owner of the Golden State Warriors.

His reason is simple. Towns keep blocking data centers. Every site that already has power gets rarer.

The numbers back him. Data Center Watch counted at least 75 US projects blocked or delayed in early 2026, worth about $130 billion.It was the worst quarter on record. Opposition groups doubled and now operate in 49 states.

Politicians joined in. More than 300 state data center bills were filed in six weeks. Maine missed becoming the first state to ban them outright by one House vote.

Why He Quit the Chip Business

He says he helped start Groq in 2016. Nvidia licensed Groq's technology last December. The deal was not exclusive. Groq founder Jonathan Ross moved to Nvidia.

Neither company gave a price, but Palihapitiya says $20 billion. Still, he would not do it again as chips have to run too fast, factories have to be too exact, and a startup cannot get enough memory.

How Much Power He Has Bought

Palihapitiya says he and his partner Anita Vlallian have acquired almost six gigawatts (GW). It arrives in stages through 2029.

One deal shows the going rate. Nasdaq-listed TeraWulf used to mine Bitcoin. In July it leased a 401-megawatt site in Hawesville, Kentucky, to Anthropic. The lease runs 20 years and should bring in about $19 billion.

Here is the part that proves his point. That site is not built yet. Power starts flowing in late 2027 and reaches full load in early 2028.

The money is committed anyway. Palihapitiya holds roughly 15 times that much capacity. His is not leased out yet, so the figure shows the size of his bet, not its value.

content_html_zh:
币安创始人赵长鹏（CZ）表示，本次熊市并不缺钱。 很多人都在寻找地方去。

在其他地方，社会资本创始人查马斯·帕里哈皮蒂亚 (Chamath Palihapitiya) 表示，他认为该项目应该落地。 不在人工智能（AI）芯片中。

熊市有钱。 它不是在购买加密货币

赵长鹏没有透露资金应该流向何处，但承认尽管处于熊市，但仍有大量流动性在流动。

这些数字表明了为什么它不进入加密领域。 比特币 (BTC) 交易价格接近 63,037 美元。 一年内下降了 45%。 这几乎正​​好是 10 月 6 日记录的一半。

查马斯购买的是土地，而不是芯片

与此同时，社会资本创始人查马斯·帕里哈皮蒂亚（Chamath Palihapitiya）是一位风险投资家、企业家和投资者，他同时购买了三样东西。 土地、电源连接和容纳计算机的空建筑。

“LPS（陆地电力壳牌）仍然是最明显、最快的现金回报方式，”帕里哈皮蒂亚写道。

帕里哈皮蒂亚 (Palihapitiya) 是 Facebook（现为 Meta）的前高管，Facebook 是著名的 SPAC 赞助商，也是金州勇士队的前少数股东。

他的理由很简单。 城镇不断封锁数据中心。 每个已经拥有权力的网站都变得越来越稀有。

数字支持他。 Data Center Watch统计，2026年初至少有75个美国项目被阻止或推迟，价值约1300亿美元。这是有记录以来最糟糕的季度。 反对派团体数量增加了一倍，目前在 49 个州开展活动。

政界人士也加入其中。 六周内提交了 300 多份州数据中心账单。 缅因州错过了成为第一个通过众议院投票彻底禁止它们的州。

他为何退出芯片业务

他说他在 2016 年帮助创立了 Groq。 Nvidia 去年 12 月获得了 Groq 技术的授权。 该交易并不具有排他性。 Groq 创始人乔纳森·罗斯 (Jonathan Ross) 跳槽到 Nvidia。

两家公司均未给出价格，但 Palihapitiya 称 200 亿美元。 不过，他不会再这样做了，因为芯片必须运行太快，工厂必须太精确，而初创公司无法获得足够的内存。

他购买了多少权力

Palihapitiya 表示，他和他的合作伙伴 Anita Vlallian 已经获得了近 6 吉瓦 (GW) 的电力。 到 2029 年将分阶段实现。

一笔交易显示了当前的利率。 纳斯达克上市公司 TeraWulf 曾用于开采比特币。 7月，它向Anthropic租赁了肯塔基州霍斯维尔的一块401兆瓦的场地。 租约为期 20 年，预计可带来约 190 亿美元的收入。

这是证明他的观点的部分。 该网站尚未建成。 电力将于 2027 年底开始供电，并于 2028 年初达到满负荷。

钱无论如何都承诺了。 Palihapitiya 的容量大约是这个容量的 15 倍。 他的赌注尚未出租，因此该数字显示的是他的赌注规模，而不是价值。
